add.title: Transgender rights in Tennessee (Wikipedia) — Prison section
add.summary: Wikipedia state-rights article, Prison section (accessed 4 Oct 2026): in April 2024 the Tennessee State Legislature passed a bill banning gender-affirming care for Tennessee inmates; and under the 2026 'Riley Gaines Women's Safety and Protection Act' transgender inmates are to be placed in prisons based on their sex assigned at birth (birth-sex placement mandate). The same 2026 Act also bans trans women from women's shelters (adjacent provision).
